name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional rule ('if you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first'), so at_exit is a condition, not a commanded goal; Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard alone is correct, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: If at_exit ever happens, switch_toggled must have happened before it.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
